entry.title: static-pie release binaries available for testing
entry.summary:
A new set of test binaries for Bitcoin has been released by Michael, known as fanquake, which can be accessed through the provided [GitHub link](https://github.com/fanquake/bitcoin/releases/tag/static_bitcoind_db73d1623957). This update is notable for the incorporation of a more recent version of glibc, specifically the 2.44 branch, marking a key development from previous versions.
The binaries are available in various formats across different architectures, ensuring broad compatibility and testing scenarios. For the aarch64-linux-gnu architecture, both debug and standard versions are offered, along with corresponding guix hashes to verify the integrity of the files downloaded. Similarly, for the x86_64-linux-gnu architecture, users have access to both debug and standard binaries, each backed by guix hashes for security verification purposes.
This initiative continues to benefit from active community involvement, where feedback and bug reporting are critical to refining and enhancing the stability and performance of Bitcoin software. The commitment to regular updates and transparent communication within the developer community helps in maintaining high standards of reliability and security in ongoing Bitcoin development projects.
